name: sample2_child_behavior_seriously
source: So it’s important not to take your child’s behavior seriously at every step of the way.
target: ですから子供の行動にいちいち真に受けないことが大切です。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 19: stable adjective and child-behavior noun anchors.

name: sample2_gaming_contract_negotiation
source: Even if you’re only good at gaming, if you can’t negotiate a contract, you’re not going to make it.
target: ゲームの腕だけあっても、契約交渉ができなければ、ダメでしょう。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 38: keep the gaming and contract-negotiation anchors.

name: sample2_web_compiler_names
source: There are a lot of web compilers out there, like Glup, WebPack, or even Grunt in the old days, and I’m sure there are many more.
target: Glup、 WebPack、さらに昔だとGruntなど、たくさんあると思います。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 55: named entities and the even->さらに modifier should stay stable.

name: sample2_outgoing_incoming_email_process_probe
source: Label outgoing and incoming emails Label your outgoing and incoming emails.
target: 送信受信メールにラベルをつける 送信メールと受信メールにラベルを付けます。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 63: a process-oriented phrase case. The incoming-email phrase should survive while the outgoing side remains useful for staging inspection.

name: sample2_publish_buzz_signs
source: I’ve published it for now, and if I see signs of a buzz, I’ll reiterate the details of the writing.
target: とりあえず公開してしまって、もしもバズる兆候が見えたときに、改めて文章の細かいところまで見直していけばいいのです。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 67: keep the publish and buzz-sign anchors without depending on the broader reiterate paraphrase.

name: sample2_video_scene_separate
source: This is because you have to watch the video and separate the scenes you want and the scenes you don’t want.
target: 動画を見て、欲しいシーン、いらないシーンを分ける作業があるからです。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 81: coordinated scene nouns and the separate verb should remain stable.

name: sample2_home_builder_specs
source: If the house is built by a home builder, it’s built to its own specifications (size) from that home builder.
target: 住宅メーカーで建築した家だと独自仕様(サイズ)になっているため、その住宅メーカーから買うしかなくなります。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 82: keep the home-builder/build/own anchors and normalize the parenthesized specification-size phrase cleanly.

name: sample2_strong_tone
source: However, you should not use a strong tone of voice.
target: ただしその時、強い口調で言ってはいけません。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 87: strong and tone are a compact sanity check for adjective+noun behavior.

name: sample2_purpose_set
source: However, it’s important not to change from the purpose you’ve set.
target: ただし、決めた目的から変わらないようにする事が大切です。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 92: purpose/set is a good unseen sanity check for the current Sudachi-first path.

name: sample2_especially_toilet_bathroom
source: This may be especially true of toilets, bathrooms and living rooms.
target: 特にトイレやお風呂場、リビングなどがそれに当たるかもしれません。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 96: keep the clean room anchors and recover the lexicalized living room -> リビング phrase.

name: sample2_live_long_break_parts
source: If you live in a house for a long time, some parts will break.
target: 長い年月をかけて住めば壊れる箇所も出てきます。
notes: Fresh sample pack row 97: several basic content anchors that were not in the main suite yet.
